agent: set/attention network trained from scratch with masked PPO (medical_uav/agents/ppo.py)

training.commit_note: the run predates run.json; its start time follows commit bfc8fb4 by one second, and that commit and the submitted code both reproduce the run's first three updates exactly

selection.rule: one checkpoint per run on the 100 selection days (demand seeds 100040-100139): low-load on-time >= 97 %, every order type within 3 points of Slack-aware at medium and high load, then the highest mean of medium and high on-time; the shipped run is the training seed whose selected checkpoint scores highest
